# M10 conversion-loss fixture — relations component (v4 §-1.4, §14, §107).
#
# Two graph-native comment Relations over the ids in doc.paragraph.txt, in
# the M03 setup vocabulary: the same `[[graph]]` shape as a `*.scenario.toml`
# fixture's `[[setup.graph]]` table (liminal_daemon::scenario::{Setup,
# SetupGraph}), so this file parses directly as a `Setup` (its `files` and
# `buffers` default empty). Per D10.1 these are the constructs the Pandoc
# adapter DECLARES lost at emit time — they are ingested into the toy graph
# but no code path in `conformance::pandoc::emit` models them, so they never
# reach the Pandoc AST (Law 8: loss is visible, never silent).

[[graph]]
kind = "comment-relation"
target = "p-laplace"
requires_grade = "explicit"

[[graph]]
kind = "comment-relation"
target = "p-sampling"
requires_grade = "explicit"
